title.narrative: Enhanced Integrated Framework Trust Fund Management

description.narrative: The Enhanced Integrated Framework (EIF) Trust Fund Management is a global partnership between the Least Developed Countries (LDCs), the EIF Donors, and the EIF Agencies. Its aim is to mobilize, coordinate, and strengthen the capacities of the LDCs in making trade an engine of pro-poor growth. The EIF empowers the LDCs to identify where trade can form an integral part of their national development strategies and assists them in harnessing Aid for Trade (AfT) and investments towards this goal. \n\nAll partners are expected to actively commit to supporting the shared objectives with their own operations, expertise, reputational assets, and program resources. This multilateral partnership is particularly important as it brings together key international actors to support the LDCs' capacities to trade while minimizing duplication and competition. It offers concerted resources to the most marginalized countries, ensuring that they are not left behind in the global economy.
